book.title: Malobhe gha Mbone ngita chighajhandikwe na Luka

content: Nnandanikiho gwa nawela na nnyomola mihalo
Bhahe, Yecho ajhakwachimulila bhabholwa bhake nnandanikiho gwa kwabhola bhajhope machiko ghoha changaleka.
Ngalongila, “Pamuche ghumo pakibha na nnyomola mihalo, jwenio anyogwipa ndeka Chapanga hilu kwapala bhando.
Helahela pakibha na nawela jhumo pamuche gwenio, jwanyendelila nnyomola mihalo jwenio kila lichiko, ‘Antangatile kuntengekela na likoko lyake!’

Kwa machiko ghamahele nnyomola mihalo jhola akapala ndeka kuntangatila nawela jwenio. Nambo kujhomolela kwake ajhakuwachila kumwojho gwake, ‘Pamonga na nenga ninyoghopa ndeka Chapanga amu kwapala bhando,
nambo nhwalo gwa nawela jhonjo ing'aha nenga nanitangatila apata chikibhii chake, anda naha ndeka najhendelela kuhikahika, na kundotoha nenga!’ ”
Bhahe, Bhambo ajhakujhendelela kulonge, “Nnyokanikiye chalongile nnyomola mihalo jwanganandela.
Bho, Chapanga nabhakengela ndeka bhando bhake bhabhahagwile, bhubhanelila muhe na kilo? Bho, natenda kiyoto kwatangatila?
Ninnobholela chakaka, nabhakengela kajhombe. Pamonga na gheniya ghoha, Mwana gwa Mundo papala kuhika, bho, nabhakolela bhando bhabhii na kihobholelo pannema?”
Nnandanikiho gwa Pwalichayo na ntola kode
Peniya Yecho ajhakwalobholela nnandanikiho kwa bhando bhala bhibhakibhona umbone na kwapucha bhange.
“Bhahe, bhando bhabhele bhajhopita pa Nyumba jha Chapanga ku Yeluchalemo. Jhumo akibha Mpwalichayo, na jhonge ntola kode.

Mpwalichayo jhola ngajhemita, kunyopa Chapanga chakumwojho mwojho, alongila, ‘Ninchenguu Chapanga, nhwalo nenga mmi ndeka ngita bhando bhange, bhibhatola ilebhe ya bhando kwa makakala amu bhatenda ghanganandela amu ngongola na ngita jhonjo ntola kode.’
Nenga nipunga machiko mabhele kwa lijuma limo, nipiya chaka kwa Chapanga ilebhe yango yoha inipata.”

“Nambo ntola kode jhola na jwenio ajhakujhema chukutale changajhinula miho ghake kunane kwa Chapanga, nambo akitobhita tobhita panganga kongo abhii ngolongonde, alongila, ‘Mwe ma Chapanga, ungolele kiya nenga mii na uhakaho!’ ”

Yecho ajhakwalobholela, “Hojho ntola kode pabhujhita kajhake kone alekekiwe uhakaho na Chapanga. Nambo jhonge jhola akalekekiwe jhe. Nhwalo jhola jwakitenda kubhehe jwandina nabhaha nkolongwa na jhola jwakitenda nkolongwa nabhaha jwandina.”
Yecho aikuchulila yana yandina
Bhando bhange bhajhakunnete Yecho yana ichokombe abhabhekele mabhoko na kuhikuchulila. Bhabholwa bhake pubhalolita naha, bhajhakwipwatalila.
Nambo Yecho ajhakwakema yana bhanhuheghelele, “Muileke yana yandina ihike kwa nenga, mangaibhilikiya. Nhwalo Unahota nkolongwa gwa Chapanga ndi kwa bhando bhibhabhii ngita bheniya.
Ninnobholela chakaka! Mundo jhojhoha jwangaupokela Unahota nkolongwa gwa Chapanga ngita mwana nchokombe, jwenio nanyingii ng'o mu Unahota nkolongwa gwa kunane kwa Chapanga.”
Kangombo jhuna ilebhe mbwe
Nkolo jhumo jwa Akayahude ajhakunkonya Yecho, “Mmola maumbone, ndende nike mme na ughome gwa machiko ghoha ghangapeta?”
Yecho ajhakunkonya, “Nhwalo gwa nike ungema nenga naumbone? Abhii jhe jwaumbone nga Chapanga kanjika.
Mulimanyite maha lilaghalikilo, ‘Nkotoka kutenda ngongola amu nkotoka kukoma, nkotoka kulonge uwange amu nkotoka kujhibha na mwatembekeya tate na majhe gwino.’ ”
Na jwenio pajhangwila, “gheniya ghoha nighakamwii punikibha nakangombo.”

Yecho pajhohina gheniya ajhakunnobholela, “Kihighalike chimo nhwengite jhe mwenga. Mukachuluche ilebhe hino inkwete, mbijha yenio makabhaghulile akahocho, na mwenga nama na ilebhe mbwe kunane kwa Chapanga. Peniya ndi uhika ungengame.”
Nambo mundo jhola pajhohina gheniya, ajhakubhehe ngolongonde hake nhwalo akibha na ilebhe mbwe.
Yecho pamonita jwenio abhii ngolongonde, ajhakunnobholela, “Dolekeya chinonwipe kwa mundo jwabhii na ilebhe twe kujhingii mu Unahota nkolongwa gwa Chapanga!
Nhwalo ijhojwike kwa kinyama chikikemwa ngamiya kuholota pa lihoto lwa luchungulo lwa mpacha, kuliku jwabhii na ilebhe twe kujhingii mu Unahota nkolongwa gwa Chapanga.”
Bhando bhala pubhajhohina gheniya, bhajhakulonge, “Bho, ghane ngohe nahotola kughombokoka?”
Yecho pajhangwila, “Kilebhe chikibhii chepa kwa mundo, kwa Chapanga kijhojhoho.”
Peniya Petile ajhakulonge, “Dolekeya! Na twenga tulekite ilebhe yoha na tunkengime mwenga!”

Yecho ajhakwalobholela, “Ninobholela chakaka, mundo jhojhoha jwahilekite nyumba jhake amu nhwana mundo amu nnongo mundo amu tate na majhe mundo na yana yake kwa nhwalo gwa Unahota nkolongwa gwa Chapanga,
napokela twe kwa machiko ghanga, na ughome gwa machiko ghoha ghangapeta ghuhika palonge.”
Yecho ilonge jha utato kuwe na kuyoka kwake

Yecho ajhakwatola bhabholwa bhake kome na babhele na kwalongolela, “Unyokanikiye mbone! Tujhenda ku Yeluchalemo, na kila kilebhe chikijhandikwe na milondole bha Chapanga cha Mwana gwa Mundo nakipitila.
Nhwalo nabhakumua kwa bhando bha ilambo henge. Na bhene nabhantendela chanake, nabhannigha maligho na kuhunii mata,
nabhachwapula yato na kunkoma. Nambo lichiko lya utato nayoka.”
Nambo bhabholwa bhake bhakamanyite jhe kilebhe chenie. Bhakahihitwe mana jha ilebhe yenio, bhakibha chehwe chikilongelwa na Yecho.
Yecho inamicha jwangalola
Yecho pabhandikila kuhika ku Yeliko, pakibha na mundo jhumo jwangalola jwatamita muupele mwa ndela lihengo lyake kwajhopa bhapeta ndela.
Pajhohina lilongo lya bhando litenda kupeta ngakonyita, “Bho, kibhii nike?”
Ngabhannyangwila, “Yecho jwa ku Nachalete itenda kupeta.”
Jwenio nganonwiya lilobhe alongila, “Yecho! Mwana gwa Daude, umonele kiya!”
Bhando bhala bhubhalongolila bhajhakupwatalila bhannobholila ntame nuu, nambo jwenio ajhakuchocha kunonoha lilobhe, “Yecho mwana gwa Daude, umonele kiya!”
Yecho ajhakujhema, ajhakwalaghalikiya bhando bhannete pabhii jwenio. Jwangalola paheghilila pahina, Yecho pankonyita,
“Bho, mipala nintendele nike?” Ngajhangwila, “Bhambo, nijhopa kulola.”
Yecho ajhakunnobholela, “Nnole! Kihobholelo chino kinamiche.”
Papalapala jwangalola jhola ajhakulola, ajhakunkengama Yecho kongo abhii mukunomba Chapanga. Bhando bhoha bhubhalolita gheniya, na bhene helahela bhajhakunnomba Chapanga.
